research_question: What fraction of mechanically selected real Python bug fixes reaches Exhibit A VERIFIED evidence under the current sandbox and proposer?

selection.source: GitHub public repositories and pull requests
selection.repository_eligibility: The default branch must contain a root poetry.lock, Pipfile.lock, or requirements*.txt accepted as fully pinned by the current Docker executor.
selection.pull_request_rule: Merged PRs with an exact case-insensitive bug label, merged from 2026-02-17 through 2026-08-31 inclusive.
selection.claim_rule: Use the PR title verbatim. Do not rewrite it or add an expected failure signature.
selection.revision_rule: The recorded fix is GitHub's merge_commit_sha and the buggy revision is its first parent.
instance_eligibility: The fixing commit timestamp is inside the registered date window.
At least one production Python file changed; paths under test, tests, testing, docs, documentation, examples, or benchmarks do not count.
Both buggy and fixed revisions have a root pinned dependency input accepted by the current Docker executor.
Both revisions and their relationship resolve through Git without manual repair.
selection.candidate_order: Within each repository, merged_at ascending; then round-robin by repository star rank.
selection.stopping_rule: Stop at 30 included instances, or report that the mechanically selected universe was exhausted.
selection.exclusions: Record every repository-level and PR-level exclusion, including candidates outside the per-repository cap or target sample. No outcome-based exclusion is allowed.

model.training_cutoff_preference: Only commits after the documented 2026-02-16 knowledge cutoff are eligible.
model.identity_rule: Record requested_model and the provider-reported confirmed identity. Codex CLI absence of telemetry remains the explicit unknown_cli_no_telemetry value.
model.pricing_snapshot: 2026-09-04: USD 4.00/M input tokens, USD 0.40/M cached input tokens, and USD 20.00/M output tokens; promotional pricing was documented through at least 2026-11-21.

execution.mode: detective with the buggy first parent as target and the fixing commit as base
execution.sandbox: Docker executor; source runs from a disposable copy, network disabled, credentials unavailable, unprivileged container
execution.outcome_retry_rule: One completed attempt per instance. Resume skips completed checkpoints. An interrupted attempt may be resumed once the interruption remains recorded; never retry merely to seek a better verdict.

analysis.headline: VERIFIED divided by all included corpus instances, including build, service, proposal, execution, flake, rejection, and timeout failures.
analysis.partial: Report PARTIAL as its own numerator and fraction; never merge it with VERIFIED.
analysis.confidence_interval: Two-sided 95% Wilson score interval for the VERIFIED fraction.
analysis.taxonomy_refinement_rule: If candidate_other_rejection plus study_error exceeds 20% of failures, refine classification without changing any underlying Case, commit the change with its reason, and report both the preregistered and refined views.
analysis.cost_rule: Report active wall time and provider-reported model spend. If any model call lacks billable usage or cost telemetry, actual model spend is unavailable rather than zero or an invented estimate.
analysis.interpretation_rule: State the observed fraction, uncertainty, exclusions, and dominant constraints before making a qualitative product-versus-research-instrument judgment. Do not alter the corpus after observing outcomes.
